mistake.l1: Chinese tā sounds the same for he and she.

segments.text: He, or she? These are two different words.
He is for a man. He is my brother.
She is for a woman. She is my sister.
Repeat after me. He is my brother. She is my sister.

native.caption: 中文里“他”和“她”读音一样，所以说英语时“he”和“she”很容易混。“he”指男性，“she”指女性：“He is my brother.” “She is my sister.” 跟着 Ama 老师读一读，更多练习在 Lexkite 应用里。

en.hook: Stop mixing up he and she!
en.caption: In Chinese “tā” sounds the same for he and she, so he and she are easy to mix up. He is for a man, she is for a woman: “He is my brother.” “She is my sister.” Read along with teacher Ama. More practice is in the Lexkite app.
